object: Polish-French physicist and chemist (1867–1934). Two Nobel Prizes in different sciences — Physics 1903, Chemistry 1911. Pioneer of radioactivity research who discovered polonium and radium. At Solvay, the experimentalist among theoreticians and the only woman in the photograph.
